edges.fact: Todoist tasks can be prioritized using the Eisenhower Matrix, labeling tasks as Urgent-Important, Important-Not Urgent, Urgent-Not Important, or Not Urgent-Not Important, focusing on the Urgent-Important quadrant first.
The Pomodoro Technique (working on a single Todoist task for 25 minutes, then taking a 5-minute break, repeated) is recommended for focusing on one Todoist task at a time.
